Header.Title: Execution Pipeline
Header.Description: Inspect the final behavior chain for observed operations and compare it with every candidate behavior registered in the host.

States.LoadFailed: Failed to load the execution-pipeline catalog.
States.NoObservedPlans: No execution plans have been observed yet. A plan appears after its operation executes or is explicitly inspected.
States.NoFilteredPlans: No observed plans match the current filters.
States.SelectPlan: Select an observed plan to inspect its applied behavior chain.
States.NoAppliedBehaviors: This operation uses the terminal handler directly because no behaviors were applied.

Messages.RefreshFailed: Failed to load the execution-pipeline catalog: {0}

Filters.SearchPlaceholder: Search by operation, component, behavior, source module, contract, or method

Plans.Title: Observed operation plans
Plans.OverviewDescription: Readable execution metadata used to understand what enters the pipeline and which policies apply.
Plans.DetailDescription: Final positions run outermost to innermost; configured order is the value used to sort matching registrations.

Registrations.Title: Registered behaviors
Registrations.Description: All candidate behaviors registered in this host, in execution order. A behavior enters an operation plan only when its type matches and its descriptor filter passes.

Diagnostics.Title: Developer diagnostics
Diagnostics.Description: Exact machine identities are kept here for support and correlation. They are intentionally hidden from the normal reading flow.
Diagnostics.ExactTypeHelp: Exact assembly-qualified CLR identity used to disambiguate types in advanced diagnostics.
Diagnostics.ExactMethodHelp: Exact method signature paired with its assembly-scoped declaring type.

Summary.Registrations: Total behavior registrations in this host; one registration may apply to many operations.
Summary.Plans: Distinct execution plans observed through execution or explicit inspection and cached by this host.
Summary.ExecutionPoints: Distinct execution-boundary categories represented by observed plans, such as event handling or hosted-service start.
Summary.Faults: Plans whose behavior chain failed to materialize; the failure is cached for the current host lifetime.

Concepts.ExecutionPoint: Stable subsystem boundary where the operation enters the pipeline, such as eventbus.distributed-handler.
Concepts.BusinessOperation: Whether the adapter marks this execution as application business work; behaviors may use it as an applicability filter.
Concepts.TransactionMode: Whether the boundary allows the registered unit-of-work behavior to wrap the whole execution automatically; None still permits explicit transactions.
Concepts.PlanStatus: Behavior-chain state: Building is matching, Ready has an available chain, and Faulted has a cached materialization error.
Concepts.BehaviorOrder: Configured sort value; lower values run earlier and outermost, with type identity breaking ties deterministically.
Concepts.Lifetime: Dependency-injection lifetime of the behavior instance: Singleton, Scoped, or Transient.
Concepts.Source: Monica module that contributed the registration; Application / host means direct host registration.

Plans.OperationName: Readable operation name derived from the invoked component and entry method.
Plans.BehaviorCount: Number of behaviors actually applied after type matching and descriptor filtering.
Plans.PlanId: Compact deterministic identifier for this policy-specific execution plan.
Plans.OperationId: Compact deterministic identifier for the underlying execution operation.
Plans.PlanKey: Canonical cache identity composed of the operation key, business flag, and transaction mode; intended for diagnostics.
Plans.OperationKey: Canonical machine identity built from the execution point, assembly-scoped types, and method signature.
Plans.Component: Concrete or contractual component type invoked at this execution boundary.
Plans.Contract: Interface used by the adapter to locate the entry method; unavailable for direct method boundaries.
Plans.Method: Concrete method invoked by this execution boundary.
Plans.Input: Type passed into the execution pipeline and its behaviors.
Plans.Result: Result type returned by the behavior chain; no-result operations use an internal placeholder type.
Plans.StartedAt: Time behavior-plan materialization started, not the business operation start time.
Plans.CompletedAt: Time behavior-plan materialization completed or faulted, not the business operation completion time.
Plans.AppliedChain: Behaviors actually executed for this operation, ordered outermost to innermost before the terminal handler.
Plans.BehaviorPosition: One-based position of the behavior in the final applied chain.
Plans.ResolvedType: Concrete behavior type resolved for this operation; open generics appear as their closed type.
Plans.RegisteredType: Behavior type originally registered with the host; it may be open generic.
Plans.Fault: Deterministic error raised while materializing this operation's behavior chain; cached for the host lifetime.
Plans.ExceptionType: .NET exception type that caused plan materialization to fail.

Registrations.Behavior: Candidate behavior implementation; it enters a plan only after input/result matching and descriptor filtering.
Registrations.OpenGeneric: Whether the behavior is registered as a generic type definition and closed using the operation's input and result types.
Registrations.DescriptorFilter: Whether an additional applicability predicate uses metadata such as execution point or business classification.
